notes.title: New Game On The Horizon! An Inter-dimensional Adventure...
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

It's been a long time. I hope everyone is well. Today I want to announce to you that my new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/876370/Somnium/]Somnium[/url] will be released on November 22nd.

Somnium is an inter-dimensional adventure game adorned with elements of dark humor. Our story begins with our protagonist coming home from work tired and getting into bed after completing his daily routines. (You will play this part again in the Prologue) During our sleep we are abducted by a dark entity from another dimension. On our journey in search of answers, we will explore colorful and strange worlds, meet interesting characters, solve puzzles, play mini-games, overcome deadly traps and platform challenges, and steal girls' hearts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32133748/50eb5e9e92a11e2597fc00dfa4a31d880e97b8be.png[/img]

The game, which offers at least 10 hours of fun gameplay, has three different endings. As you progress in dimensions, the structure of the game also changes gradually and includes different playing styles. For example, we will fight bosses and do quests by controlling a baby dragon in one of the dimensions. In order to survive among the natives in another dimension, we will need to camouflage and decorate our cave with the upgrades we find. We will play basketball with little forestlings in another dimension. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32133748/9449920d0c04b44c64b616a3abe823673f45a120.png[/img]

Interactions are an important part of the game and it is possible to find surprises and strange things waiting for us in every corner of the game world. First of all, I should point out that you don't need to play Suna to understand the story of the new game, although the story is partially connected, there is a much bigger and different story. However, those who have played Suna can also find some small references that will make you smile in the new game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32133748/1c36b0b3c884f3495bb7832f961ae525d61286d0.png[/img]

There is also some erotic content in the game, so the game will be published as "Adult Only". If you haven't checked the option to see adult games in your profile settings, you may not be able to see the game when it is released. So if you don't want to miss the game, don't forget to add it to your wish list now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/876370/Somnium/

notes.title: Big Update Has Arrived! v1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

It’s been 3 months since Suna has been released. Today, I’m going to publish a big update I made for you. With this update, Suna has many improvements, such as new animals that improve the atmosphere of the game, new story content, and a linked puzzle, NPC’s are now talkable, new animations and a customized mouse cursor. 


Another news is that I’ve been working on a new project. I can say that it will be a very different game in style. It will be a fun game with interactive focus, riddles and platform stuff. If everything goes well, I hope to finish the game late summer. Of course Suna will be getting updates regularly, there are still lots of stuff I have planned but right now I am focused on preparing my new game.


Note: The new story contains a bit of a hard puzzle. The only clue I can give is that, in order to begin this new story you have to find something in the town. You can speak with townsfolk for getting more clues.


- Key Features -

* A short story content and a linked puzzle have been added. When you solve it you will witness the beginning story of the new game I’m working on and you will win a new achievement. 
* Many new animals have been added to various areas, including deers, rabbits, butterflies, frogs, crabs, scorpions, birds, snails. The game world is more alive now!
* You will be able to talk to NPC’s in town and in other areas.
* If you get closer to Warrok, you may come across an unpleasant surprise, and the pirate on the beach can now chase you and kill you when he sees you.
* Some new NPC animations have been added.
* The girl in the lake is now swimming slowly, but be careful that she may not like to be bothered.
* A new mouse cursor has been added.
